summary: Parent economy data model editor implementation meets all acceptance criteria with clean hexagonal architecture and comprehensive testing.

strengths.description: Excellent application of hexagonal architecture with clear separation between domain (GameEconomy, EconomyParameter), ports (ManageEconomyPort, GameEconomyStorePort), and adapters (ManageEconomyService).
EconomyParameter class with original/current value tracking enables automatic diff generation. Smart use of value objects with validation (min/max bounds).
get_modified_parameters() method provides complete audit diff with original values, current values, and descriptions. EconomyAdjustedEvent captures all changes for parent review.
Comprehensive test coverage with mock implementations. Tests verify load, adjust, diff generation, event emission, and reset functionality.
Clean port interfaces with clear method signatures. Default parameter values in domain objects reduce boilerplate.
Graceful degradation with null checks and fallback to defaults (GameEconomy.new with defaults).
Proper use of Godot types (RefCounted for shared objects, class_name for global registration).

suggestions.description: Consider adding @export hints to EconomyParameter properties if this will be used in the editor UI.
The set_value method in EconomyParameter uses clampf which is good, but consider adding a warning/error message when value is out of bounds for better parent feedback.
The GameEconomyStorePort.load_economy() returns GameEconomy.new(world_id) as fallback. Consider adding a created_at timestamp to track when defaults are first applied.

notes: The implementation follows the hexagonal architecture pattern perfectly: domain objects contain no Godot-specific code, ports define interfaces, and services implement business logic.
The EconomyParameter inner class is a nice touch for encapsulating parameter behavior with validation.
Default economy parameters cover the three required categories: prices, spawn_rates, and progression_multipliers.
The test file uses a clean mock pattern that can be reused for other service tests.
All acceptance criteria from the backlog are met: parents can edit prices/rates/multipliers, and all changes generate auditable diffs.

decision.reason: Implementation meets all acceptance criteria with clean architecture, comprehensive testing, and no blocking issues.
